01

Foundation Builder

Build consistency with a steady ruck and a few basic strength movements.

  • Warm up with an easy unloaded start.
  • Ruck at a sustainable pace for a planned distance or time.
  • Finish with simple carries, squats or step-ups if appropriate.
02

Hill Repeats

A short route with a climb can do more than an aimless long session.

  • Choose a safe hill you can repeat and descend comfortably.
  • Climb strongly; use the descent to recover.
  • Stop when form or pacing falls apart, not just when you are exhausted.
03

Urban Ruck

Use the city for route discipline, stairs and changing surfaces.

  • Build a loop with clear crossings and easy escape points.
  • Include stairs or hills if they fit the group.
  • Track total distance, elapsed time and how the load felt.
04

Team Challenge

Make a hard session social and useful without turning it into a race against the slowest participant.

  • Agree on the challenge and an accessible alternative.
  • Share route decisions, navigation and group support.
  • Finish together, then compare what each person learned.
